name: jobmatch-web
description: React islands for the JobMatch Flask app. Builds into ../static/dist, which .cpanel.yml already copies. Flask keeps owning every URL; this is not a single page app.
_scriptsNote: Binaries are invoked through node rather than npm's bin shims. This repo sits under a folder whose name contains an ampersand, and the generated .cmd shim splits the path on it, so `tsc` resolved to <home>\Desktop\typescript\bin\tsc and the build failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Calling node directly sidesteps the shim and behaves identically on Linux CI.
